summary: Aggressive civ with a weak economy that needs to deal damage. Mongols often spear or tower rush from the Dark Age, then aim for a Kurultai timing at 12 to 15 minutes with Keshik and archers.
openings: Dark Age barracks with 150 wood for a spear or tower rush, often on the gold.
Deer Stones, or the Silver Tree on trade maps.

spikes.label: Dark Age rush
spikes.detail: A barracks in the Dark Age means spears or a tower on your gold.
spikes.answer: Pull villagers to fight the tower early, go Feudal and make archers.

spikes.label: Kurultai timing
spikes.detail: Kurultai with Keshik and archers hits at 12 to 15 minutes.
spikes.answer: Have spearmen and archers grouped when it lands.

scout: A barracks in the Dark Age means a spear or tower rush

winConditions.detail: They need to deal damage early; their economy is weak.

howToBeat: Survive the early aggression; their economy falls behind.
Don't overreact to a spear rush: get the gold, go Feudal, make archers.
